svg.text: Shift + NOTE. Root, scale, layout, transpose and MIDI channel.
Root note select + scale viewer (piano layout)
MIDI channel for note mode (Ch 1-8, then 9-16)
Open with Shift+NOTE (a latched page - press again or tap NOTE to return). Everything here is saved to flash.
Transpose: +/-12 semitones. Chromatic/Scale toggle: bright orange = scale mode (pads play scale degrees only).
Shown: root C, Natural Minor, channel 1 selected.
